title: DON'T HANG UP
status: composition and recording plan; no recorded vocal sample or finished audio

Hook — eight lines; two bars per line at: Don't hang up, don't hang up,
Let me hear you breathe when the words get stuck.
Got a room with a view, still the blinds stay shut;
I don't need the right words, just don't hang up.
Don't hang up, don't hang up,
You ain't gotta fix what you didn't fuck up.
We can let the clock run; we ain't gotta rush.
Stay a little, stay a little—don't hang up.
Verse 1 — sixteen bars at 148 BPM; one w: Key card bent, third try—green light.
Same jeans, I been gone three nights.
Whole crowd knew every word on stage;
Fridge hum fills up the room where I stay.
Sent Mom rent; she sent three hearts.
Typed “I'm tired,” then erased that part.
I learned “I'm good” from watchin' her
Work two shifts with her back still hurt.
Saw your name flash, let it fade to black,
Like you owed me words I never gave back.
Called that “space”—you called it what it was:
“You only let me in when it gets bad.”
Had a whole speech lined up in my head.
You cut it short: “You eaten yet?”
I let a laugh out, then I lost my breath;
You heard the part I hadn't said.
Pre-Hook — four bars at 148 BPM: Then I stopped myself this time.
Hook 2: Don't hang up, don't hang up,
Let me hear you breathe when the words get stuck.
Got a room with a view, still the blinds stay shut;
I don't need the right words, just don't hang up.
Don't hang up, don't hang up,
You ain't gotta fix what you didn't fuck up.
We can let the clock run; we ain't gotta rush.
Stay a little, stay a little—don't hang up.
Verse 2 — sixteen bars at 148 BPM; one w: New place, couch still wrapped in plastic.
Bought it for the nights I kept imagin'.
Four seats; I eat standin' by the sink.
Tell me what that extra space was fixin'.
Pay for quiet; can't make it feel safe.
TV on, don't know what's playin'.
Used to call that peace; now I'm not so sure.
Same keys, took me weeks to open up the door.
Your name lit up at a quarter to three.
Your “I'm good” sounded just like me.
Had a joke, let it go, let you breathe;
For once, I didn't make it all about me.
Kettle clicked; we were both talkin' soft.
Stayed till your five-a.m. alarm went off.
Nothin' got solved—we still said goodnight.
I slept with the TV off for the first time.
Final Hook — same topline; the request b: I won't hang up, won't hang up,
Let me hear you breathe when the words get stuck.
Got a room with a view, let the blinds come up;
You don't need the right words; I won't hang up.
I won't hang up, won't hang up,
We don't gotta fix it all before the sun's up.
We can let the clock run; we ain't gotta rush.
Stay a little, stay a little—I won't hang up.
